_meta.description: New Iterable Handlebars helpers added in 2026. Supplement to schema/helpers.json.
_meta.feature_flag_note: groupBy and sortBy both require the HandlebarsArrayHelpers feature flag to be enabled for the project. When the flag is off, helpers return empty string with no error.

groupBy.name: groupBy
groupBy.description: Groups an array of objects by one or more field values. Outputs a list of group objects each containing the key values and the items belonging to that group.

array.description: The array of objects to group. Can be a template variable, event data path, or catalogCollection output.

field.description: Comma-separated list of field paths to group by. Dot notation supported for nested fields. Example: field="category" or field="shipping.method,shipping.date"

groups.description: Array of group objects, in first-seen insertion order.

group_object.key: Object containing the group key fields, accessed via full dot path matching the field= parameter.
group_object.count: Number of items in this group.
group_object.items: Array of the original objects that belong to this group.

key_access_rule.rule: Access group keys using the FULL field path from the field= parameter.
key_access_rule.common_mistake: Using leaf name only: field="LineItems.ItemShippingMethod" → {{group.key.ItemShippingMethod}} (WRONG) → use {{group.key.LineItems.ItemShippingMethod}} (CORRECT)

limits.behavior_when_exceeded: Silently truncates to 100 items. No error thrown.

behaviors.group_ordering: First-seen insertion order — the key that appears first in the array appears first in groups.
behaviors.empty_array: Renders the block with empty groups array. Wrap content with {{#if groups}} for empty-state handling.
behaviors.null_values: Items where the field is null/missing are grouped together under a null key.
behaviors.at_index_warning: @index, @first, @last inside {{#each group.items}} reflect the outer groups loop, not the inner items iteration. Use named block params instead: {{#each group.items as |item iIdx|}}

rei_order_confirmation.description: REI-style: sort by date, group by shipping method + date, inner sort by price

sortBy.name: sortBy
sortBy.description: Sorts an array of objects by one or more field values. Returns a new sorted array — the original array is not modified.

array.description: The array of objects to sort.

field.description: Comma-separated field paths. First field is primary sort. Additional fields are tiebreakers. Example: field="priority,name"

order.description: Sort direction. Applies to all fields when multiple fields given.

behaviors.type_detection: Auto-detects field type (Date / Number / String) from the first non-null value. No explicit type parameter needed.
behaviors.nulls: Null values always sort last regardless of asc/desc direction.
behaviors.multi_field: First field is primary sort key. Subsequent fields break ties. All fields use the same order= direction.
behaviors.composition: sortBy can wrap groupBy, and groupBy can contain sortBy. Full nesting confirmed working.
behaviors.immutability: Does not modify the input array — returns a new sorted array.

basic_price_sort.description: Sort catalog items by price ascending

multi_field_sort.description: Sort by priority desc, then name asc as tiebreaker

sort_then_group.description: Pre-sort to control group insertion order
sort_then_group.why: groupBy preserves first-seen key order. Pre-sorting forces groups into the desired sequence.

sort_within_groups.description: Group first, then sort items within each group

catalogCollection.name: catalogCollection
catalogCollection.description: Fetches all items from a named Iterable Catalog Collection and provides them as an array for looping, indexing, or passing to groupBy/sortBy.

collection_name.description: Name of the catalog collection as defined in the Iterable UI. Case-sensitive.

output.description: Array of catalog item objects. Fields are flattened from dataFields to top level.
output.max_items_note: Iterable catalog collections are capped at 50 items.

field_access.rule: All catalog item fields (including those backed by dataFields) are accessed directly at the top level of each item object.
field_access.wrong: {{item.dataFields.brand}} — dataFields wrapper is not present in Handlebars context

index_access.description: Access specific items by zero-based index

catalog_setup_requirements.field_mapping_order: CRITICAL: Set ALL field type mappings BEFORE loading items. Field types set after ingestion do not apply retroactively.
sequence: 2. Set field mappings for all fields (name, url, price, imageUrl, description, categories, plus all custom fields)
catalog_setup_requirements.standard_fields: Standard catalog fields (name, url, price, imageUrl, description, categories) must also be mapped explicitly — they are NOT automatically typed.
